parole.significato: cart, telega (a simple, open four-wheeled horse-drawn vehicle for transporting cargo and/or people)
parole.testo: Inherited from Proto-Slavic *telěga, or perhaps, ultimately, from Khazar [Term?]. Compare Serbo-Croatian tàljige / Serbo-Croatian та̀љиге, Czech taliha, Old Church Slavonic телѣга (telěga).
